reason: Select a second physical-target-disjoint three-door cohort for direct confirmation of the four-surface representation, excluding every target in all six predecessor 3RScan cohorts before RGB and model access.

overrides.question: Does the four-surface reference/query responsibility split transfer unchanged to another three physical 3RScan doors selected before RGB or model access?

frozen_cohort.selection_order: Use frozen candidate area order; exclude every physical (reference_scan_id, target_instance_id) in six consumed cohorts regardless of rescan; require unique physical targets inside this cohort; allow at most two per reference scan; accept the first three passing unchanged geometry/depth visibility rules. Open zero RGB and zero models during selection.

overrides.claim_boundary: This is pre-RGB and model-blind physical-target-disjoint same-provider source admission. It uses privileged 3RScan geometry, pose, depth and semantics and may share scan families or backgrounds with prior work. A later unchanged pass can establish only same-provider Development confirmation of the four-surface component, not raw-camera binding, provider-independent generalization, named entrance, ownership, access, traversability, arrival, handoff, Android, benefit, reliability or safety.
